name: quarterly-review
title: Quarterly customer review
for_each: select id,name from success.accounts order by name

sections.title: Agreed outcomes
sections.sql: select name,due_on,status,evidence from success.objectives where account_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Next actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,status from success.actions where account_id=$1 order by due_on

name: renewal-brief
title: Renewal decision brief
for_each: select id,name from success.accounts order by name

sections.title: Contract history
sections.sql: select name,renews_on,arr_cents,currency,status,evidence from success.contracts where account_id=$1 order by renews_on
sections.note: Internal review. This document is not an offer or signed renewal.

sections.title: Recent conversations
sections.sql: select name,occurred_on,sentiment from success.touchpoints where account_id=$1 order by occurred_on desc

name: success-plan
title: Customer success plan
for_each: select id,name from success.accounts order by name

sections.title: Customer outcomes
sections.sql: select name,due_on,status,evidence from success.objectives where account_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Action register
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,status,evidence from success.actions where account_id=$1 order by due_on
